Platelet dysfunction and oculocutaneous albinism define disease; restrictive pulmonary dysfunction in 3/7 supports lung involvement despite fibrosis reported in only 1/7.
Microcephalic primordial dwarfism defines this Seckel subtype; intellectual disability, microcephaly and short stature each reported in 3/3.
Persistent conjunctival inflammation; the umbrella does not establish a specific infectious or immune-mediated cause.
Indolent malignant B-cell disorders; lymphoma qualifies for the immune mechanism axis. No additional organ is consistently affected across subtypes.
Anal, ear/hearing and thumb malformations form the defining triad; kidney malformations or dysfunction occur in approximately 40%.
Benign neoplasm confined to the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Progressive neurodegeneration and vision-destroying optic atrophy define disease; motor weakness and associated foot deformities do not establish primary muscle disease.
Anaerobic bacterial infection of the meninges.
Malignant B-lymphocyte neoplasms; lymphoma is explicitly included in the immune mechanism axis.
Inherited retinal photoreceptor dysfunction causing impaired acuity, color vision and dark adaptation.
Hereditary motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting and vocal cord paralysis arise from denervation rather than separate muscle or airway disease.
Defining skeletal dysplasia; hearing impairment and auditory canal stenosis in 2/2; strabismus and blepharophimosis frequent (30-79%).
Mitochondrial energy disorder with extraocular skeletal muscle myopathy causing progressive ophthalmoplegia; additional neurologic disease varies by subtype.
Severe chronic neutrophil deficiency affects blood cells and innate immune defense; autoimmune causation is excluded, and infections are secondary complications.
Neoplasm originating in breast tissue, which has no axis.
Alveolar surfactant accumulation impairs lung function; approximately 90% of cases are autoimmune, supporting the immune axis across the umbrella.
Inherited hypertrophic narrowing of the gastric pylorus causes gastric outlet obstruction.
Inborn serine synthesis defect defined by neurodevelopmental impairment and seizures; feeding difficulties alone do not establish gastrointestinal injury.
Sarcoma arising in or occupying the telencephalon.
Repeated alveolar hemorrhage damages lungs; blood-loss anemia is part of the defining diagnostic triad. Underlying cardiac or immune diseases are separate causes.
Lung disease and T-cell immunodeficiency define syndrome; eczematoid dermatitis in 2/4. Cerebral calcification in 2/2 lacks clear evidence of functional injury.
Poliovirus damages medullary motor neurons; respiratory and swallowing dysfunction are neurogenic, and muscle wasting reflects denervation.
Leukodystrophy with episodic memory impairment establishes cerebral white matter disease.
Lymphatic vascular malformation causes lower-limb lymphedema in 2/2; tortuous lymphatic vessels reported in 1/2.
